scale.notes: All four partial first floor plans on this sheet are at the same scale, printed beneath each drawing title. Title block scale is 'AS NOTED'.

keynotes.description: Remove existing doors. Patch all disturbed surfaces to match existing adjacent surfaces.

Remove existing aluminum clad window(s), metal frames, transoms, hardware, saddles, side-lites, window treatments, trim, anchors, sealant, adhesives and all related items. Patch all disturbed surfaces to match existing adjacent surfaces.
Remove existing sealant, fasteners and all related items.

Contractor to perform partial removal of existing wood / hollow metal frame to determine actual field conditions and prepare shop drawings. It is the intent of this project to remove the existing frame(s).
Remove existing hardware from existing doors (exit devices, closers, removable mullions). Reinstall all hardware on new doors. Coordinate new door and frame preparations with existing hardware.
Clean cast stone bands, repoint and cover all horizontal & vertical joints.
Remove and replace cast stone window trim. See detail 7/A702.
Clean cast stone window heads, repoint and cover all horizontal & vertical joints.
Clean cast stone sills, repoint and cover all horizontal & vertical joints.
Refasten loose grille.
Stonework above doors to be recaulked by district, N.I.C. Contractor to clean and seal after recaulking is complete.
Patch holes in face brick (approx. quantity: eight (8) bricks).
Rake out and repoint brick mortar joints in delineated areas (±100 LF). See detail 3/A430 (typ.).
Contractor to remove existing caulk and recaulk expansion joints.

Repoint horizontal joint at lintels between windows and at corners. At single windows, repoint horizontal joint at window corners, repoint three courses of brick above lintel. (Base bid quantity: twenty-one (21) lintels, alternate 2 quantity: four (4) lintels).

Install new FRP door, aluminum thermally broken door frame, and reinstall existing door hardware. Door FRP color to match one story building. See door details & schedule. Contractor is responsible for building security while doors are being replaced.
Scrape, wire brush, prime and paint existing steel lintel. Color to match existing precast units.
Install steel tubing and beam around door opening to reinforce existing lintel.
Temporarily remove existing/displaced masonry around door and reset after steel tubing is in place.

Remove loose brick around lintel, scrape, wire brush, prime and paint all exposed portions of steel lintel. Install new flashing and brick veneer (quantity: two (2) lintels). Contractor to work in a manner which provides continuous support to masonry above. See detail 5/A701.
Repair cracked brick. See detail 2/A430 (typ.).
Refasten loose fascia cover.
Remove and dispose of brick in areas noted. Install new brick, matching existing color and texture. See detail 1/A430 (typ.).
Repoint vertical joints and outer head joint of brick arch.
